based_on_template: IRCC secure account status update email (generic structure)
input:
From: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada <donotreply@cic.gc.ca>
Subject: An update has been made to your application

Hello,

There has been an update to your application in your IRCC secure account. Please sign in to view the details.

This is an automated message, please do not reply.

IRCC

output.special_note: Status update only, no amount or deadline specified - requires manual login to review.
